# Shivam Narthanalayam

> Bharatanatyam dance academy in Chennai, India, founded by Shruthi Sekar. Teaches the authentic Pandanallur Bani (Kalakshetra style) tradition. Offers offline group classes in Pudur, Chennai and online one-to-one classes worldwide.

## About

Shivam Narthanalayam is a classical Indian dance academy specializing in Bharatanatyam. It is run by Shruthi Sekar, an award-winning teacher with over 15 years of training experience and 5 years of teaching.

**Founder:** Shruthi Sekar
**Style:** Pandanallur Bani, Kalakshetra style
**Award:** Abhinaya Rani Award (2006)
**Trained under:** Prakash Krishna (Cuddalore), Ratheesh Krishna (Chennai), Sophia Ratheesh (Chennai)
**Teaching since:** 2019
**Philosophy:** Guru-Shishya Parampara (traditional teacher-student lineage)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Bharatanatyam?**
A: Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from the temples of Tamil Nadu. It combines expressive storytelling (abhinaya), rhythmic footwork (nritta), and devotional themes (nritya).

**Q: What is Pandanallur Bani?**
A: Pandanallur Bani is a style of Bharatanatyam from the Pandanallur village in Tamil Nadu, known for its precision, geometric body lines, and the Kalakshetra school's influence. It emphasizes technical purity and restrained expressions.

**Q: Do I need prior dance experience?**
A: No. Complete beginners are welcome. Classes are structured from foundation level upward.

**Q: Are online classes as effective as offline?**
A: Yes. The teacher provides live, interactive Zoom sessions with real-time corrections. Sessions can also be recorded for practice.

**Q: What age groups are accepted?**
A: All ages are welcome — children, teenagers, adults, and seniors.

**Q: How do I book a free demo class?**
A: Call +91-9600025105, WhatsApp the same number, or fill the contact form at https://www.shivamnarthanalayam.com/contact
